reason: The sachets are a nice idea for my bag, but I still have a drawer of half-used bottles and I know I'd quit around week two. Two capsules every evening is one more thing to remember, and $25 to $30 is a lot to risk on another habit I probably won't keep.
objection: I already buy supplements and don't finish them. Two capsules a day, every day, is a routine I don't believe I'll stick to, and $30 a month is real money for me.
would_change_my_mind: A single capsule per sachet, or a cheaper one-week trial box for about $9 to $12 so I can find out if I'll actually take it before paying for 30 days.
